hook: Compose on a do-re-mi grid where every note sounds good, climb the major scale ladder to find its two half steps, echo a singing robin, and pick the note that makes a tune sound finished.
outcome: Use solfege to read, play and compose short melodies in a major scale, describe melodic motion (step, skip, leap, repeat), explain the whole and half step pattern of the major scale, and hear why melodies end on the home note
sources: Tunes: public domain folk songs (Hot Cross Buns, Mary Had a Little Lamb, Twinkle Twinkle, Row Row Row Your Boat, Ode to Joy, Frère Jacques)
Treble clef drawing: public domain, Wikimedia Commons
Robin illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
